name: Synthetic boxes (AI-generated images, not photographs)
source: generated for this project; see eval/synthetic/README.md for the model, date and prompts
ground_truth: eval/synthetic/manifest.csv, planned by eval/plan_boxes.py before any image was generated; each image was checked by eye against its row and regenerated or dropped when it didn't match
note: Every product, reference photo and box photo in this set is AI-generated. It tests the agent on scenarios planned in advance, at no packing cost; it does not show how the agent does on real photographs. Results are reported separately from every real-photo set and are never blended with them.
